create.title: Create database
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.
create.publicHint: Exposes the database on a direct TCP port for external tools.
create.urlHint: Use an endpoint reachable from deployed app containers. For a native database on the VPS, PostgreSQL must listen on a container-reachable host address, not only 127.0.0.1.
create.externalHint: External databases are linked and injected into apps, but lifecycle, backups, and password rotation stay outside Ploydok.
create.formHint: Provision a managed database or register an existing PostgreSQL endpoint.
create.progressHintManaged: Waiting for the API to provision the database and confirm it is healthy.
create.progressHintExternal: Saving the external PostgreSQL endpoint and encrypted connection string.

link.title: Link database
link.description: Inject database connection variables into this app at deploy time.
link.empty: No running databases in this project.
link.prefixError: Must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (letters, numbers, underscores only)
link.prefixHint: Generates PREFIX_URL, PREFIX_HOST, etc. Default DATABASE gives the app DATABASE_URL.

adminer.title: Open Adminer
adminer.description: Adminer will be locked to this database. Reveal and copy the generated database password before opening Adminer.

restore.title: Restore database
restore.overwrite: {{name}} will overwrite the current database contents. This action cannot be undone.
restore.fromBackup: Restoring from backup {{id}} will overwrite the current database contents. This action cannot be undone.
restore.replace: and replace it with the backup contents.
restore.destroy: This will destroy all current data in {{name}} and replace it with the backup contents.
restore.ageHint: The backup is age-encrypted. Paste your private key here — it will not be stored.

reveal.title: Reveal connection string?
reveal.description: The connection string contains sensitive credentials. It will stay visible for 30 seconds, then auto-hide. Make sure no one is looking over your shoulder.

backup.endpointHint: Leave empty for AWS default, or use a provider endpoint for R2, Scaleway, OVH, Backblaze, Wasabi, or any S3-compatible storage.
backup.secretHint: Create a secret in your app with JSON value { "accessKeyId": "...", "secretAccessKey": "..." }.
backup.ageHint: before upload. The private key is only needed at restore time and is never stored by Ploydok.
backup.encryptHint: When set, each backup is encrypted with age before upload. The private key is only needed at restore time and is never stored by Ploydok.

backupsList.inventoryUnavailable: The backup inventory could not be verified. Sizes and ages are hidden until the destination can be checked.

list.description: Provision, protect, and operate every database in this workspace.
list.fleetDescription: Runtime health, exposure, application links, and backup protection.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search name, engine, host, or app…
list.emptyBody: Provision the first database for this workspace.
list.filteredBody: Clear the filters to return to the full fleet.

detail.title: Database
detail.externalHint: Ploydok stores and injects the connection string, but the database process, firewall, backups, and password rotation are managed outside Ploydok.
detail.directPublicHint: Internal linking always keeps the private endpoint.
detail.publicWarningTitle: This database will be reachable publicly
detail.publicWarningBody: The container port will be bound to 0.0.0.0 on the host. Any client able to reach this server on the allocated port can attempt to connect with the generated credentials. Make sure your firewall only allows the IPs you trust before applying.
detail.externalAlertBody: Lifecycle and password rotation stay with the PostgreSQL server owner. Use the connection tab to reveal the stored URL or link this database to apps.
detail.adminerUnavailable: Adminer is available for managed PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB databases.
detail.monitoringUnavailableBody: Ploydok only collects container metrics for managed database containers. Monitor this PostgreSQL server from its host or provider.
detail.monitoringEmpty: No live container snapshot found for this database yet.
detail.backupsExternalBody: Ploydok does not run backup or restore jobs against external PostgreSQL endpoints yet. Keep the server or provider backup policy enabled before linking production apps.
detail.backupsHint: Manual and scheduled backups for this database.
detail.policyHint: Store locally or on S3-compatible storage such as R2, AWS, Scaleway, or OVH.
detail.externalLogs: External databases do not have Ploydok container logs.

toasts.rotationStarted: Password rotation started — apps will be redeployed
toasts.passwordExtractFailed: Unable to extract password from connection string
toasts.clipboardHint: Select the password field and copy it manually.
toasts.redeployHint: Redeploy the app for the new variables to reach the container.

restart.title: Restart database
restart.body: The database will briefly be unavailable.
restart.progressHint: Waiting for the API to confirm the fresh container is healthy.
restart.confirmHint: This will restart the database container and wait for healthchecks to pass before marking it ready.
restart.summary: The runtime will stop, provision a fresh container, run health probes, then restore the database endpoint.

rotate.title: Rotate database password
rotate.description: This will generate a new password, update all linked apps, and trigger a rolling redeploy. The old password remains active until all apps are healthy (max 5 min double-write window).
rotate.warning: All apps linked to this database will be redeployed automatically. If rotation fails, the old password will be restored.
